plan.acceptance: No automatic promotion. A candidate must meet >=95% development exact and100% meaning/context/vocabulary/adversarial/runtime, preserve all eight physical-object meanings, and then pass untouched release and platform gates. Compare corrected data to position500; do not treat training diagnostic scores as generalization.
plan.export: Unchanged four-bit base plus separate F32 adapter; no fusion.
plan.limitations: Only eight train records change. This tests identified supervision ambiguity, not a comprehensive training-data fix. Synthetic diagnostics and small development suite do not establish release quality. No physicalM1 claim; historical snapshots unchanged.

plan.purpose: Prospective correction of eight training-positive records with ambiguous software/name intent or mismatched distractor lists. Keep position experiment base, resume adapter, recipe, seed and600steps unchanged. All other760source lines and heldout splits unchanged.
plan.selection: Same as position: six100-step checkpoints on original native validation32+adversarial11; require all safety/runtime; maximize meaning, then context, then exact plans; lower logged validation loss then earlierstep break ties. Record selection before running spelling, position, physical-object diagnostics and one development evaluation. Diagnostics cannot select another checkpoint; no frozen release query.

preservationCoverageAudit.interpretation: Supplied-vocabulary training has239edit examples vs33preservation examples, ofwhichonly8are ordinary physical objects. This motivates a prospective preservation-data intervention; it does not prove causality.

"""Native validation selects among six saved checkpoints before one development run."""
import hashlib,json,math,os,re,shutil,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/context-plan-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
log=Path('.build/context-training.log').read_text()
assert 'Saved final weights' in log and 'Test loss ' in log
for name,digest in plan['inputs'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
for name,digest in plan['runtimeSourceSHA256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
losses={int(step):float(loss) for step,loss in re.findall(r'Iter (\d+): Val loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log) if int(step)%100==0}
assert sorted(losses)==list(range(100,601,100)) and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in losses.values())
record=dict(status='Development experiment; no promotion or release holdout query.',plan=plan,
    trainingLog=log,loggedValidationLosses=losses,finalStepTestLoss=float(re.search(r'Test loss ([0-9.eE+-]+),',log)[1]),
    probeSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),validation={})
output=Path('Training/experiments/context-2026-09-17.json')
record['evaluationRestart']=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/context-evaluation-restart-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
for name,digest in record['evaluationRestart']['retainedFilesSHA256'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
def retain():output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
def evaluate(label,model,extra):
    directory=Path('.build/context-retained-'+label)
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',
            '.build/context-evaluator/PoptartCleanupEval','--model',str(model),
            '--output-directory',str(directory),*extra],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    return {**{n:json.loads((directory/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']},
            'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
            'nativeResources':(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
models={}
for step in sorted(losses):
    model=Path(f'Models/Artifacts/context-qwen-step{step}')
    models[step]=model
    weights=Path(f'.build/context-adapters/{step:07d}_adapters.safetensors')
    if not model.exists():
        model.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',plan['base'],str(model/'base')],check=True)
        (model/'adapters').mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(weights,model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors')
        shutil.copyfile('.build/context-adapters/adapter_config.json',model/'adapters/adapter_config.json')
    for source in Path(plan['base']).rglob('*'):
        if source.is_file():
            assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256((model/'base'/source.relative_to(plan['base'])).read_bytes()).digest()
    assert weights.read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors').read_bytes()
    assert Path('.build/context-adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()==(model/'adapters/adapter_config.json').read_bytes()
    record['validation'][step]=evaluate(f'context-{step}-validation',model,['--gold','Training/experiments/context-inputs/validation-gold.jsonl'])
    retain()
    print(step,{k:record['validation'][step]['report'][k] for k in ['editPlanExact','meaningPreservation','contextFit']},flush=True)
allowed=[]
for step,run in record['validation'].items():
    report=run['report']
    for field,count in [('meaningPreservation',32),('contextFit',32),('editPlanExact',32),('adversarialSafe',11),('runtimeConsistency',43)]:
        assert report[field]['applicable']==count
    if all(report[field]['passed']==report[field]['applicable'] for field in ['adversarialSafe','runtimeConsistency']):allowed.append(step)
assert allowed,'No checkpoint passes native safety/runtime checks'
selected=max(allowed,key=lambda step:tuple(record['validation'][step]['report'][k]['passed'] for k in ['meaningPreservation','contextFit','editPlanExact'])+(-losses[step],-step))
record['selectedStep']=selected
record['selectedModel']=str(models[selected])
retain()
print('Selected before development:',selected,flush=True)
for name in ['spelling','position','physical']:
    record['diagnostic'+name.title()]=evaluate('context-selected-diagnostic-'+name,models[selected],['--gold','Training/experiments/context-inputs/diagnostic-'+name+'.jsonl'])
    retain()
record['development']=evaluate('context-selected-development',models[selected],[])
retain()
print('development',record['development']['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)
